verdict.rationale: The read-job endpoint takes a documented output-format parameter that accepts srt, vtt, or webvtt (defaulting to JSON), so developers can retrieve captions directly through the API. Configurable segment duration (6–30s) shapes caption timing, and a live OpenAPI spec backs the documented path. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the SRT/VTT output works as documented.
